notes: §1985:XIII.4.4.4 GR2: 'The INITIATE statement does not place the file associated with the report in the open mode; therefore, an OPEN statement with either the OUTPUT phrase or the EXTEND phrase for the file must be executed prior to the execution of the INITIATE statement' (1985 states no result for a violation). ReportWriter.Initiate opens nothing and, through CobolFile/FileRegistry.OpenModeIfOpen, takes no action unless the connector is open OUTPUT or EXTEND (2023's defined result, ReportFileModeError raising only when checking is enabled), one path for every edition. Probes p13: INITIATE with no OPEN, then GENERATE and TERMINATE, open no file and write nothing; OPEN OUTPUT then INITIATE prints BODY 2; INITIATE after CLOSE takes no action, so a later OPEN EXTEND and INITIATE append BODY 3; P11A: INITIATE after a failed OPEN (status 38) takes no action. Classes e (OUTPUT, EXTEND, no OPEN, closed, failed OPEN). The witness runs OPEN OUTPUT before INITIATE.

next.reason: Both require OPEN OUTPUT or EXTEND before INITIATE; 1985 states no result for a violation ('an OPEN statement with either the OUTPUT phrase or the EXTEND phrase for the file must be executed prior'). 2023 §2023:14.9.21.4 GR3 defines one: 'If the file connector is not open in the output or extend mode, the EC-REPORT-FILE-MODE exception condition is set to exist and no action is taken on the report'; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR7 restates the order. Undefined run-time result became a defined exception condition.
